name: Promotional hardgoods
required_inputs: exact style/part/variant; material/coating; surface and method; imprint evidence; setup/run/quantity costs; stock and freight freshness
workflow: Canonical product → configured source option → complete landed quote → art/proof review → approved supplier requirement → shipment/reorder.
exception_conditions: ambiguous part; unverified print area; substitution; stale landed cost; rights or product-safety evidence missing

name: Decorated apparel and headwear
required_inputs: style/color/size matrix; fabric/construction; zone/seam limits; method and decorator; digitization/underbase/transfer needs; blank-to-decorator route
workflow: Size grid → exact variant → shared logo project → method-specific review → blank supply/decoration/QC → wearer or company delivery.
exception_conditions: cap curvature or seam conflict; unknown fabric compatibility; art differs from approved variant; missing digitization or sew-out evidence

name: School, team and fundraiser programs
required_inputs: organization/authorized buyer; campaign dates/timezone; product/size eligibility; intended user/use; minimum aggregation; pickup/shipping and allocation policy
workflow: Program membership → assigned catalog/brand → selection → close/minimum review → approved batch → distribution; retain allocation references.
exception_conditions: campaign expiry; minimum not met; applicable children’s-product evidence unknown; complex settlement unavailable

name: POD and small-run merchandise
required_inputs: provider variant and print file contract; actual minimum; region/fulfillment origin; current cost and shipping; billing trigger; substitution permission
workflow: Validated configuration → customer agreement/payment gate → approved provider draft/confirmation → event reconciliation → packages/claims.
exception_conditions: similar-item substitution; insufficient billing capacity; unverified print file; duplicate or uncertain submission

name: Commercial flat print, publications and stationery
required_inputs: finished/flat size and units; stock/caliper; page count/sides/binding; color/output condition; bleed/trim/safe from producer; file roles and finishing
workflow: Product family specification → original artwork → registered proof/preflight → frozen manufacturing specification → print/finish/QC/dispatch.
exception_conditions: wrong page geometry; unembedded fonts; unknown output intent; missing back or finish file; proof/turnaround delay

name: Direct mail and variable-data print
required_inputs: mail class and delivery objective; piece dimensions/weight; addressing/recipient rights; barcode/clear zones; data merge fields; mailing partner and acceptance
workflow: Print specification + authorized variable data → merge/sample review → postal preparation acceptance → mailing evidence and cost references.
exception_conditions: personal data exposed; invalid mail qualification; unconfirmed postage or delivery promise; missing mailing-partner acceptance

name: Signs, wide format and applied graphics
required_inputs: substrate and finish; actual dimensions/scale; viewing/use environment; panel joins and cut paths; installation/site/permit scope; device/media profile
workflow: Project/site intake → supplier-specific media and artwork rules → panel/finish review → print/cut → installation or shipping handoff.
exception_conditions: scale mismatch; unknown contour/tooling; site or permit requirement unresolved; material/device mismatch

name: Exhibitions, displays, tents and event kits
required_inputs: hardware/model; panel template/source revision; fabric/material; event in-hand date and destination; venue requirements; assembly and split freight
workflow: Campaign project → exact component/panel specs → coordinated art → multi-source agreement/jobs → consolidated or approved split delivery.
exception_conditions: generic tent image used as dieline; deadline excludes proof/freight; unverified venue requirements; component arrives after kit assembly

name: Labels, stickers and converting
required_inputs: facestock/adhesive/liner; application conditions; roll/sheet and unwind direction; die/contour and gap; ink/white/varnish; regulatory claim and end use
workflow: Application-specific configuration → registered print/cut/finish roles → producer preflight → print/conversion/QC → traceable batch.
exception_conditions: wrong adhesive or unwind; die/finish misregistration; unsubstantiated food/chemical/sustainability claim; missing producer acceptance

name: Packaging, corrugated and folding cartons
required_inputs: style/classification; dimensions and measurement convention; material/board grade; producer-approved dieline; cut/crease/glue/no-print roles; content/use/jurisdiction
workflow: Packaging brief → producer source/dieline → panel-aware artwork → finish/preflight → print/conversion/assembly → shipment/QC.
exception_conditions: style code mistaken for exact tooling; unapproved structural design; wrong panel orientation; unsupported environmental or contact-use claim

name: Awards, drinkware, gifts and engraving
required_inputs: exact blank/material/coating; usable area/curvature; fixture and method; raster/vector roles; finish and personalization data; producer sample/acceptance
workflow: Exact blank → permitted decoration option → customer visual approval → specialist route evidence → QC and protected shipment.
exception_conditions: photograph mistaken for scale; unknown coating or fixture; unapproved vector becomes toolpath; breakage or wrong personalization

name: Industrial, safety and custom-engineered sourcing
required_inputs: intended use and technical requirements; drawings/spec revisions; material and performance claims; jurisdiction/responsible party; qualified manufacturer review; test/certification evidence where applicable
workflow: Assisted technical RFQ → source/engineering review → documented quote and approvals → specialist production handoff → inspection/reconciliation.
exception_conditions: unsupported safety claim; decorative art mistaken for engineering/CAD; unknown compliance responsibility; unverified substitution

name: B2B company stores, redemption and recurring programs
required_inputs: company/location/member grants; approved catalogs and brand revisions; budgets/allowances; commercial terms and seller; date/renewal policies; delivery and service rules
workflow: Program eligibility → configured catalog → atomic commitment/approval → order/jobs → delivery → reconciled usage → repeat/reorder.
exception_conditions: lost store/brand context; concurrent overspend; expired allowance; unapproved credit; complex settlement unavailable

name: Bundles, kitting, warehousing and fulfillment
required_inputs: kit bill of materials; component quantities and variants; inbound/assembly/outbound destinations; packaging/labor; receipts and QC; partial shipment policy
workflow: Frozen kit agreement → component purchase requirements → receipts → assembly/QC → exact package allocations → actual cost closeout.
exception_conditions: kit identity/cost lost in cart; missing component; freight counted once for multiple legs; shipment quantity exceeds accepted production

name: Design, prepress, proof and media interchange
required_inputs: immutable original and editable revision; exact product/configuration tuple; physical vs pixel geometry; source/media/font rights; provider output profile; proof/technical review/recipient acceptance
workflow: Shared original → editable design → illustrative preview → independent proof decision and technical checks → approved derivative/route handoff.
exception_conditions: zero interpreted as unknown; generic DPI/bleed defaults; flattened import called native editable; stale proof; private source leakage

name: Distributor operations, economics and owner workload
required_inputs: source validity/cost components; quote and acceptance history; role/approval limits; actual costs/financial references; tasks/exception causes; owner and delegated time entries
workflow: Assigned inquiry → bounded staff decisions → governed exceptions → reliable event-driven follow-through → reconciled profit and workload metrics.
exception_conditions: sales growth mistaken for profit; stale supplier cost; capped KPI dataset; unobserved payment/PO success; unmeasured owner time savings
